Learn/Lakers/Luka Dončić

Scouting report · games through Nov 6

Luka Dončić.

The league's leading scorer. He makes defenses choose between the drive and the step-back, then punishes whichever they pick. He has scored 40 or more in six of his last seven games.

No. 77 · Lakers · 6′8″ · 9th NBA season

Signature move

The step-back three.

He sells the drive with a hard jab, crosses the ball back between his legs to his left as he hops back off both feet, and rises before the defender recovers. At 6-foot-8 he releases over most guards, so a late contest rarely bothers the shot.
